RESOLVED: Dear Dana Whitfield,

Thank you for reaching out regarding the denial of your MRI claim (CLM-550193). 

"Prior authorization not on file" means that the specific procedure (the MRI) required approval from Meridian Health Plan before it was performed, and we did not receive that request from your provider's office.

You have the right to appeal this decision. According to our policy (KB-2207), you have 180 days from the date of your denial notice to file a first-level appeal. I recommend contacting your doctor’s office to ask them to submit a "retrospective authorization request" along with the clinical documentation supporting the medical necessity of the MRI for your migraines. This is often the fastest way to resolve this type of denial.

If you would like to proceed with a formal appeal, please let me know and I can provide you with the necessary appeal form (FORM-APP-1). Standard appeals are typically processed within 30 calendar days. 

This ticket is now resolved. Please let us know if you have any further questions.
